name: Dropdown Terminal
author: Hung Vo
description: Summon the configured default terminal in a floating special workspace

barWidget.description: Toggle the default terminal as a dropdown

schema.label: Show icon
schema.description: Show the dropdown terminal icon in the bar.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph or text shown for the terminal button.

schema.label: Auto-hide on focus loss
schema.description: Hide the terminal by toggling its animated special workspace when another window receives focus.

schema.label: Allow focus through dropdown
schema.description: Let normal windows receive pointer focus while the floating dropdown is open. Adds a managed input.special_fallthrough override to your Hyprland config.

schema.label: Auto-hide delay (milliseconds)
schema.description: Wait briefly after focus changes before hiding the terminal.

schema.label: Terminal width (%)
schema.description: Width of the dropdown terminal as a percentage of the focused monitor.

schema.label: Terminal height (%)
schema.description: Height of the dropdown terminal as a percentage of the focused monitor.

schema.label: Border color
schema.description: Use theme to follow Omarchy, or a Hyprland color such as rgb(ff8800).
